comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
There are three exceptions about the PvE VS flagged fleets:

1) When you're the defender instead the attacker (happens only by Ottoman Navy/Privateers).
2) During the Storylines/Quests that they occur (you're often the defender).
3) Epic Sea Feud to gain merit of wars and victory points.

Under these circumstances it won't result any penalty for your fame or nation relationship.

Hope this helps ^^
